criteria.title: Duplicates
criteria.description: Score this independently. Award 1 if the submission explicitly explains that retaining one record per repeated record_id prevents a repeated upload from counting the same observation twice. Merely reporting that a duplicate was removed is not a justification. Otherwise award zero. Cite one short exact sentence supporting this item.

criteria.title: Invalid
criteria.description: Score this independently. Award 1 if the submission justifies excluding a missing target or a physically invalid load rather than inventing or clipping an unsupported value. Otherwise award zero. Cite one short exact sentence supporting this item.

criteria.title: Impute
criteria.description: Score this independently. Award 1 if the submission justifies median imputation of missing ambient temperature while retaining the original raw data. Otherwise award zero. Cite one short exact sentence supporting this item.

criteria.title: Limitations
criteria.description: Score this independently. Award 2.5 if the submission identifies at least one meaningful limitation: synthetic data, small sample, repeated equipment observations or imputation uncertainty. Otherwise award zero. Cite one short exact sentence supporting this item.

criteria.title: Use
criteria.description: Score this independently. Award 2.5 if the submission restricts use to teaching/practice, or explains that deployment requires representative measured data. Equivalent wording is valid. Otherwise award zero. Cite one short exact sentence supporting this item.
